pairs: Given that f(x) = 5x^3 - 2x + 3, find the value of f(2).

Substituting x=2 into the function f(x) = 5x^3 - 2x + 3 results in f(2) = 5(2)^3 - 2(2) + 3. Continuing with the arithmetic operations, 5(2)^3 = 40, -2(2) = -4, and adding 3 gives us 40 - 4 + 3 = 39. Therefore, f(2) = 39.
